items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: I used to could whistle, so I'd whistle anything anybody played, and so could Snagg's Joan.

ctx.x: My mother started to call me playing music. I never would have got one myself, and then she had the little horn on the bed, I never would forget that. And I stuck with it until she passed. And so that's all I could do. But I guess she could see that I wanted to play music. She could see. I used to could whistle, so I'd whistle anything anybody played, and so could Snagg's Joan. And Joe Oliver used to have me to whistle to get ideas from me. Now you might not believe that. So he had me and Snagg's to whistle, and…
You could hear them for miles. Did you ever play a little Ken flute or anything?
